Contacts.title: Contacts
Contacts.body:
Every customer and vendor in this workspace: companies and people, with roles, segments and a detail view covering master data, history and finances.

Duplicates are combined through merge. Larger sets arrive through import with a duplicate check.

Nothing is deleted: a contact referenced by documents is archived, so every issued document keeps its recipient.
